axes_source: Read from data/brands/ea.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #FF4747 and the canvas #0D0D0D; contrast from the ink #FFFFFF on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FF4747; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 4, 8px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 150ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #FF4747 reaches 5.78:1 on the canvas #0D0D0D, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: EA
